definition: Segmenting objects through video given only an initial mask, propagating it with memory and motion cues.
details: Segmenting objects through video given only an initial mask, propagating it with memory and motion cues.

explainer.lead: Semi-supervised video object segmentation segments objects through a video given only an initial mask. It matters because it spares per-frame annotation once an object is marked.

tiers.eli5: You outline an object once in the first frame, and the system follows it through the rest of the video.
tiers.practitioner: Systems propagate the initial mask using memory and motion cues. A pitfall is drift when objects are occluded or change appearance over long sequences.
tiers.paperLevel: Segmenting objects through video given only an initial mask, propagating it with memory and motion cues.

explainer.example: An annotator masks a pedestrian in frame one, and the system carries the mask across every later frame.
